description: This file appears to be a shell script related to git operations, including tag management, commit creation, and date handling. It contains functions for manipulating git references, creating unique commits, managing author information, and processing commit dates.

methods.name: tag
methods.description: Verifies existence of a git tag and retrieves its revision hash.

methods.name: unique_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit with unique text and a specified tree from a git tag.

methods.name: save_tag
methods.description: Saves output of a command into a git tag, updating the ref and modifying sed scripts.

methods.name: entag
methods.description: Replaces sha1 hashes with symbolic references in a sed script.

methods.name: as_author
methods.description: Executes a command with a different GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL environment variable.

methods.name: commit_date
methods.description: Extracts the commit date from a git commit hash.

methods.name: assign_fake_date
methods.description: Assigns a fake date to a variable based on input format.

methods.name: on_committer_date
methods.description: Runs a command with a specified fake committer date.

methods.name: on_dates
methods.description: Runs a command with specified fake committer and author dates.

methods.name: hide_error
methods.description: Runs a command suppressing error output.

methods.name: check_output
methods.description: Checks command output against expected content with error suppression and comparison.

methods.name: name_from_description
methods.description: Transforms a description string into a safe, lowercase, hyphenated name for testing.

methods.name: test_output_expect_success
methods.description: Runs a test expecting the command output to match expected input.
